chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
A man asked him, while I was present, about the wealth of a slave: “Is zakat obligatory upon it?”
So he said: “No, even if he had a million dirhams; and if he were in need, there would not be anything for him from zakat.”

key_terms.أَلْفُ أَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ: a million dirhams, indicating a very large amount of wealth
key_terms.احْتَاجَ: became needy or fell into need
key_terms.الْمَمْلُوكِ: the slave; a person under ownership in the legal context of the hadith
key_terms.زَكَاةٌ: the obligatory alms-tax discussed in the ruling
key_terms.شَيْءٌ: anything; any share or amount from zakat

ai.seo_question: Is zakat obligatory on the wealth of a slave, and can a needy slave receive zakat?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that zakat is not obligatory on the property of a slave, even if the amount is very large. It also states that a slave, if needy, is not entitled to receive from zakat, indicating a specific fiqh classification related to ownership and legal status.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1634 - Abdullah ibn Sinan narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:
A man asked him in my presence about the wealth of a slave: "Is Zakat obligatory on it?"
The Imam (as) replied: "No, even if he possesses a million dirhams. Moreover, if he were in need, he would not be entitled to receive anything from Zakat."
